shadow.definition: Original target always executed. For each attack the candidate would reject/change, follow original cohort to departure from attack at that target plus 1200 ticks. Damage includes summons; paid loss excludes workers/expiring units. towerKilledLoss means ANY tower last hit. Later events are baseline shadow queries, not candidate trajectories. Windows can overlap.

paidHits.definition: Charged tower damage to the original cohort excluding ids listed as expiring front members. Lethal means an observed lethal hit by a charged tower, not all tower last hits.
